game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge, a ridge shrouded in ash: the ember mage must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Smoke Ridge: a ridge shrouded in ash
core_gameplay_loop: In Smoke Ridge, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, a new fire gems challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 440 points of fire gems by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 440, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Compound Combo' (Week 2 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Smoke Ridge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Smoke Ridge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 440 within 38 seconds.
